birth_registration.name: Birth Registration
documents: Hospital birth letter or health post certificate
Citizenship certificate copy of both parents
birth_registration.fee: Free within 35 days, Rs. 100 after 35 days
birth_registration.hours: Sunday to Friday, 10 AM to 5 PM

death_registration.name: Death Registration
documents: Hospital death certificate or verbal autopsy report
Citizenship certificate of the deceased (if available)
death_registration.fee: Free within 35 days, Rs. 100 after 35 days
death_registration.hours: Sunday to Friday, 10 AM to 5 PM

marriage_registration.name: Marriage Registration
documents: Citizenship certificate copies of both spouses
Two passport-size photos of each spouse
marriage_registration.hours: Sunday to Friday, 10 AM to 5 PM

map_approval.name: Map Approval
documents: Building design map by licensed engineer
map_approval.fee: Varies by municipality - contact ward office
map_approval.hours: Sunday to Friday, 10 AM to 5 PM

tax_payment.name: Property Tax Payment
tax_payment.fee: Based on property valuation, 5% penalty if late
tax_payment.hours: Sunday to Friday, 10 AM to 5 PM

business_registration.name: Business Registration
documents: Rental agreement or ownership proof of business location
business_registration.fee: Rs. 500 to Rs. 2000 depending on business type
business_registration.hours: Sunday to Friday, 10 AM to 5 PM

social_security_allowance.name: Social Security Allowance
documents: Proof of age (senior citizens) or disability card (if applicable)
social_security_allowance.hours: Sunday to Friday, 10 AM to 5 PM

migration_certificate.name: Migration Certificate
migration_certificate.hours: Sunday to Friday, 10 AM to 5 PM
